## Purpose

Validate Vault before engineering spend.

## Gate

- [ ] Runway scenario recorded in DEC-NEXT-001
- [ ] Interview target list prepared
- [ ] Tracker ready
- [ ] Calendly/interview slots ready

## Scope

- [ ] Recruit 30 respondents
- [ ] Complete interviews
- [ ] Apply politeness filter
- [ ] Fill vocabulary log
- [ ] Write Day-7 decision memo
- [ ] Record DEC-NEXT-002
